posts.name: SHARKBAITM8
posts.cooked:
Seriously, it’s getting out of control - and no, I don’t think it’s as simple as ‘skill diff’. Pixel bots are, and have been a thing for well over a decade at this point. Only now, it’s easier than ever to make. Have them do kicks at various intervals to seem more ‘real’, only do them 75% of the time, etc. You’ll feel like a nut for even thinking something ‘off’ is taking place.

Things like picture perfect stop casts with ranged hunter kicks, killing totems, reflecting survival disarm, deathing ccs, shadowmelding cc, fade cc, the list goes on. Sub <100ms reaction times (literally inhuman, not one offs but repeated).

Anyone with half a brain can make one of these, and use them. It’s so simple you can probably put this together in less than 10 minutes. If you deny this, you’re either unaware of the issue, or you’re cheating yourself.

Here’s the formula:
Step 1) Make a weakaura in that sits as one pixel in the corner of your screen. Have the weakaura change to a specific color on spellcast success for instance.
Step 2) Ask ChatGPT to make you a 10 line Python script that automatically presses a key for you when that specific pixel on your screen changes color (facilitated by your weakaura).
Step 3) Apparently, profit.

I’m just scratching the surface of what’s possible with this, the actual applications can be WAY more neferious with these scripts even help pilot your character for you. When are we going to see Blizzard start addressing cheaters in this game.

This is an epidemic, and feel I see AT LEAST one of these in each lobby.

One offs sure, but having healers that are impossible to kick on ranged like MM or BM in the 2200 range? Yeah, sus. AWC level stop casts, and even then I don’t think these guys are pulling off such a successful stop cast ratio that these healers do. No other fake casts thrown throughout the game otherwise.

I’ve had a priest auto fade the moment I threw my trap (not off CD). Ironically, it would still autofade even if I was halfway across the map and would still hit because of the time it took for it to fly through the air (fade would run out by the time it got there).

More importantly, what’s stopping someone from going into ChatGPT and making that pixel bot. There are no punishments or proper anti-cheat system in place.
